name: Flat with black
blurb: Solid black shapes, denim and leaf green
mechanism: Flat, outline-free colour shapes in four saturated mid-tones, anchored by large solid black masses (20-40% of the painted area), with black reused as thin 0.75-1.6 detail lines and white as thin seams on the black.

line: No outlines on coloured fills; ink #15202f detail lines 0.73-1.6 (fingers 0.75, flaps 1.05, glasses 1.5), white seams 0.85-1.0 on black, ground line 1.25, round caps and joins.
rules: No outline on any coloured shape; only white shapes get an ink edge.
Make hair, trousers, shoes or a device solid black.
Far limbs take the same hue one step darker.
Figures 5.2-5.5 heads tall with big shoes on the ground line.
Exactly two stars and two plus-sparkles, nothing else floats.
Centre the group; side margins near 90 px.
